svg.title: Kikuchi Hojudo historical object context
svg.desc: Kikuchi Hojudo's official roots page identifies a 1926 exposition-award tetsubin, while the government feature records shrine and daily goods and a wartime interruption.
svg.text: Kikuchi Hojudo: historical context named by the workshop
The official roots page names an award-winning tetsubin from 1926.
It supplies historical context, not a mark, mould route, or direct authentication key.
Government feature: shrine goods → domestic ware; wartime interruption; postwar return.
Sources: Kikuchi Hojudo official roots page and Government of Japan feature. No historical object photograph was reused.
